entities.summary: Syed Amir-uddin Kedwaii PMGM was a Pakistani barrister, politician and independence activist, known for designing the national flag of Pakistan. He was posthumously awarded the 'Pakistan Movement Gold Medal' in 1991 by the government of Pakistan, for his efforts during the Pakistan Movement.
